title: Trust-calibration event
description: One line of trust/events.jsonl in the private store: a fact the trust-calibration loop counts per area (design part 2.15). Append-only. The data is collected from the first run; nothing acts on it until the milestone Trust calibration, and nothing here changes anyone's autonomy.

kind.description: asked: a question went to a decider. answered: it was answered. worth-asking: the decider rated whether it was worth asking. application: a precedent resolved a question. overrule: the owner reversed an application. reversal: the owner reversed a call the system made without a precedent. precedent-created, precedent-narrowed, precedent-retired: the precedent's life. merge-approval: the owner approved a branch the merge queue had checked and presented (owner merge mode, design 14.2), one event per area it changes. merge-reverted: a merge the owner approved was later reverted.

area.description: The area it belongs to; "unassigned" when none applied.

subject.description: The decision item, or what was reversed.

candidates.description: asked: the precedents that were candidates when the question was sent.

agrees_with.description: answered: the candidate precedents the answer is consistent with.

generalization.description: answered: what the decider said to the precedent offer.

facts.description: asked and application: the question's structured attributes, kept so an overrule can narrow the precedent to cases like it.

worth_asking.description: worth-asking: the rating (was worth before HITLD-82).

subject_kind.description: reversal: the kind of call reversed (was what before HITLD-82).

commit.description: merge-approval: the commit the approved branch merged as.

latency_ms.description: merge-approval: from the batch being presented to the owner's approval.

as_presented.description: merge-approval: true when the owner approved the whole batch as presented, false when they named a list that left some out.
